items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: And of course the next big artist I recorded was a girl named Alma Thomas, which is here now. I recorded her. She had her number, which one would care. She stayed with me for about four or five years.

ctx.x: Because he signed with Shaw after he signed with Shaw before my contract was even up.

And that's what we really had, that's what he was really scared of, you see. Right. Well that wasn't a lot of pay. Shaw had a lot of good odds in those days. They were making a lot of money, you know. They flew the guy in here and brought me a check. We didn't have to go to the coach. We just, well we filed a suit against him. And when they filed a suit against him, they paid off in a sweats, you know. So that was the biggest artist that I recorded. I mean, that's what I won't get down to. That was the biggest…
So, let's go back to Slim. When, when, how, do you know anything about how, we'll get to a few things, how Slim, how Slim died?
